_meta.notes: Two distinct modes: light (marketing/browse/settings) and dark (learning environment/code editor/quizzes). The platform uses a warm, approachable light mode with a serious, focused dark mode for active learning.

primary.role: Primary CTAs, progress bars, active indicators, countdown timers, promo banners. The signature Codecademy yellow.

secondary.role: Secondary actions (Sign Up buttons, filled buttons), category accents, social auth highlight (Facebook), certification badges, course type indicators. Deep indigo-violet.

tertiary.role: Skill tracking headers, sidebar active indicators, lighter purple accents on skill/subskill pages.

page.role: Main page background — warm cream/beige, not stark white

surface.role: Card backgrounds, form containers, modal backgrounds

elevated.role: Slightly raised sections, alternating content blocks

page.role: Primary dark mode background — deep navy, not pure black

surface.role: Card/panel backgrounds in dark mode, sidebar, kanban columns

elevated.role: Hover states, active items, elevated cards in dark mode

editor.role: Code editor background — darker than page

overlay.role: Quiz backgrounds, celebration screens, focus overlays

muted.role: Metadata, timestamps, secondary info, placeholder text

heading.role: Headings and titles in dark mode

muted.role: Secondary text, metadata in dark mode

link.role: Links in dark mode use primary yellow

yellow.role: Primary actions, progress, streaks, free content

orange.role: Illustrations, decorative elements, quiz personality results

teal.role: Success states, completion indicators, review complete text

blue.role: Informational, quiz option borders, selected states in dark mode

green.role: Success badges, completed tasks, correct answers

success.role: Correct answers, completed steps, success messages

error.role: Form validation errors, incorrect answers, password warnings

interactive.hover: Slight darkening of fill color or subtle background shift (observed on nav items, buttons)
interactive.focus: Visible outline — appears to use browser default or thin dark outline (inferred)
interactive.active: Background fill for selected nav items, bold weight for active sidebar links, left border accent for active settings items
interactive.disabled: Reduced opacity (~0.5) and desaturated colors (inferred from grayed-out pricing features)

families.notes: Headings use a slightly heavier geometric sans (possibly Apercu or custom). Body uses Graphik or similar grotesque. Code editor uses a dedicated monospace. All inferred — exact font names may differ.

xs.usage: Badge labels, tiny metadata, countdown timer digits

sm.usage: Card metadata, footer links, breadcrumbs, form hints

base.usage: Body text, form labels, nav items, descriptions

lg.usage: Section headings, course titles in cards

5xl.usage: Large display text on marketing pages (inferred)

usage.500: Nav items, card subtitles, form labels
usage.600: Card titles, button labels, sidebar active items

letterSpacing.tight: -0.02em — used on large display headings (hero text)
letterSpacing.wide: 0.02em — uppercase badge labels, 'SAVE $100', skill level labels (inferred)

element.notes: Gap between icon and label, between badge items, between inline elements

component.notes: Internal padding of cards, buttons, form inputs

card.notes: Card content padding, gap between card sections

section.notes: Between page sections (e.g., 'Start learning' to course cards)

grid.notes: Card grids use 16px gap. Sidebar + main layout with ~240px sidebar.

usage.0px: Sharp corners on some section dividers, table borders
usage.4px: Small badges, tags, code inline blocks, checkboxes
usage.8px: Buttons, form inputs, cards, modals, dropdowns — the primary radius
usage.12px: Larger cards, pricing panels, course detail hero cards
usage.24px: Social auth buttons, countdown timer container
usage.9999px: Pill badges ('New', 'Pro'), avatar circles, progress dots, toggle switches

subtle.usage: Cards on light backgrounds — very subtle, relying more on border than shadow

medium.usage: Dropdowns, tooltips, AI assistant chat panel

large.usage: Modals, share dialogs, interview builder overlay

shadows.notes: Codecademy uses shadows sparingly in light mode — most depth is created through background color contrast (cream page bg vs white card bg) and thin borders. Dark mode uses no visible shadows; depth is from background luminance tiers.

thin.usage: Card borders on light backgrounds, form input borders, table dividers, footer separator

medium.usage: Active/focused input borders, selected card emphasis

accent.usage: Active sidebar item left-border indicator, selected filter highlight

dark.usage: Card borders in dark mode, quiz option borders, dividers in editor

darkAccent.usage: Selected quiz option border in dark mode — lighter blue

light.logoStyle: Outlined bracket wordmark with code brackets: [code]cademy
light.navItems: text-base, medium weight, dropdown arrows on Catalog/Resources/Community/Pricing
light.rightSide: Search icon, notification bell (logged in), avatar (logged in) OR 'Log In' text + 'Sign Up' filled button (logged out)

promoBanner.contains: Countdown timer (days:hours:min:sec in bordered segments) + promo text + CTA button

course.structure: Optional colored top-bar accent | Title (semibold) | Description (body text, 2-3 lines) | Footer: [difficulty badge] [duration] [certificate icon]
course.topAccent: Some cards have a colored top border (yellow for free, purple for pro courses)

event.structure: Title (bold) | Date + time | Description (truncated) | Attendee count bottom-right

pricing.structure: Plan name | Price ($XX.99/mo, 4xl) | Billing note | Feature list with check/x icons

kanbanTask.structure: Checkbox icon (purple when done) | Title (semibold) | Description (muted, truncated)

primary.usage: Start, Get Started, What's Next?, Explore Bootcamps, Start 7-day free trial, Reserve your seat

secondary.usage: Sign Up, Submit answer, Sign Up (in navbar), Evaluate, Resume, Learn

outline.usage: Learn More, Save and exit, I do not know, Back, Compare plans, View path

ghost.usage: Skip personalization, View Your Certificate, inline text links acting as buttons

dark.usage: CTAs on dark backgrounds (same yellow but contextual — What's Next?, Save + Run)

authenticated.items: Icon + label, base size, medium weight
authenticated.activeIndicator: Left border accent (3px purple), bold weight, possibly light purple bg tint

settings.activeIndicator: Left border accent (3px purple/dark), bold weight

codeEditor.layout: Three-panel: left sidebar (file tree) | center (code + tabs) | right (preview/output)

editorPane.tabBar: File name tabs at top, close button, active tab highlighted

previewPane.toolbar: URL bar with localhost:8000, back/forward/reload, expand buttons

toolbar.topBar: dark.surface bg, centered breadcrumb (my_directory / ProjectName), right side: Get Unstuck, Tools, Share (green outline), Avatar
toolbar.saveRun: Primary yellow 'Save + Run' button, bottom-right of editor pane

lessonProgress.type: Segmented colored bar (in lesson nav header)
lessonProgress.colors: Green/yellow segments for completed, gray for pending

pagination.type: Centered 'X / Y' counter with thin progress bar below

level.style: Outlined pill, small text, icon prefix (person/chart icon)

tag.style: Outlined rectangle, small text, border-radius sm
tag.usage: Topic tags on course/subskill pages: 'HTML & CSS', 'Mobile development', 'Web design'
tag.colors: Light: dark text on white bg with dark border. Dark: muted text on transparent with muted border

xp.style: Inline '64 XP' or '+100 XP' with yellow text in dark mode

footer.layout: 6-column grid: Company, Resources, Plans, Subjects, Languages, Career building + Community
footer.linkStyle: sm text, muted color, no underline until hover
footer.bottomBar: Social icons (X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube) + App Store / Google Play badges

chatPanel.header: Gradient purple top bar with 'AI Learning Assistant' label
chatPanel.messageStyle: Chat bubbles — user right-aligned, AI left-aligned
chatPanel.inputBar: Bottom text input with send button

tabs.style: Underline tabs — text with bottom border accent on active
tabs.usage: Catalog filters (All, Languages, Subjects), event filters (Upcoming, Your events, Past events), code editor file tabs

countdown.digits: White text in individually bordered segments (days:hours:min:sec)

patterns.marketingHero: Full-width dark/image background, centered or left-aligned heading + CTA, optional right-side image/illustration
patterns.browseGrid: Sidebar filters (left) + main content area with card grid (2-4 columns responsive)
patterns.courseDetail: Full-width colored header (purple/yellow accent) + white content below, right-side 'This course includes' card
patterns.learningEnvironment: Dark mode, three-panel: left instruction sidebar + center code editor + right preview
patterns.settingsPage: Left nav sidebar + right content area, clean form layouts
patterns.dashboardHome: Left nav sidebar + main area with stacked sections: promo banner, recommended courses grid, progress cards
patterns.quizFullscreen: Dark mode, centered content, question + answer options stacked, bottom pagination

breakpoints.mobile: < 640px — single column, hamburger nav, stacked cards
breakpoints.desktop: 1024px+ — full sidebar, 3-4 column grids, three-panel editor
breakpoints.notes: Inferred from page structure, not measured

illustrations.style: Flat vector with limited palette — yellow, orange, navy, white. Geometric shapes. Pencil/book/laptop/trophy motifs.
illustrations.celebrationScreen: Confetti particles (multicolor small shapes) on dark navy background with large yellow trophy icon
illustrations.personalityQuiz: Large orange geometric shapes (triangles) for personality result illustrations
illustrations.onboarding: Simple flat icons — book, mobile device, certificate — in yellow/orange/navy

animation.textRotation: Hero 'Develop your /skills' appears to cycle through words (skills, career, etc.) — typewriter/rotation effect
animation.confetti: Celebration screen likely uses animated confetti particles
animation.transitions: Hover states likely use ~150-200ms ease transitions on buttons and cards (standard practice)
